milestone: SeLinOS Phase 13 network N1 root-only QEMU e1000 firmware BAR0 range validation

platform.fixture: QEMU e1000 PCI device with firmware-assigned BAR0

validated_contract.precondition: N1 re-reads and exact-matches N0 scalar identity before any configuration write.
validated_contract.bar_policy: Accept only a non-zero, firmware-assigned, 32-bit memory BAR0.
validated_contract.sizing_transaction: Quiesce PCI memory decoding and bus mastering; write all ones only to size BAR0; restore BAR0; read back BAR0; restore PCI command word; read back command word.
validated_contract.result: Return scalar paddr, size and bar_index only after overflow-safe 32-bit range validation.

required_markers: SeLinOS network N1: e1000 firmware BAR range validated and restored; no MMIO/IRQ/DMA/NIC authority.
SeLinOS network N1: no BAR frame, mapping, IRQ, DMA, bus mastering or packet I/O.
forbidden_markers: network N1: e1000 firmware BAR range validation failed

not_claimed: BAR frame capability or BAR mapping
PCI command-register enable or bus-master enable after the exact restore transaction
NIC driver domain, device reset, transmit or receive descriptors
Ethernet frames, IP, DNS, TCP, HTTP(S), repository access
IOMMU or IOSpace containment, time/trust verification, dpkg or apt support
